help.enabled: With this on, a corporate email signs in against the directory; with it off only local passwords work.
help.bindDN: A read-only account used to search the directory, not a login account. Most AD setups refuse anonymous reads, so leaving it empty usually returns nothing.
help.bindPassword: The platform never writes to the directory; this only reads it. Empty means an anonymous search.
help.startTLS: Upgrade the connection to TLS on port 389 (instead of using ldaps).
help.tlsInsecureSkipVerify: Only for a self-signed certificate you cannot import right now.
help.caCertPEM: Paste the directory's CA certificate here instead of skipping verification.
help.timeoutSeconds: Connection, search and bind share this timeout; 5 to 15 seconds is plenty.
help.baseDN: Where to start looking for users, e.g. dc=corp,dc=local. Pick it off the tree below.
help.userFilter: Keep the %s placeholder: it becomes the escaped sign-in email.
help.attrUniqueId: The stable account key — it survives an OU move or a rename. AD: objectGUID, OpenLDAP: entryUUID.
help.attrUsername: The fallback key when the unique id is missing. AD: sAMAccountName, OpenLDAP: uid.
help.attrDisplayName: The name shown after sign-in. AD: displayName, OpenLDAP: cn.
help.requiredGroupDN: Empty means anyone in the directory may sign in. Narrow it to one group first.
help.groupMatchInChain: With this on, members of nested groups count too (AD nested groups; the search is slower).
help.autoProvision: With this off, an operator must create the account before a directory user can sign in.
help.linkPolicy: What happens when a directory email already has a platform account.
help.disableOnMissing: When someone leaves and their entry disappears, the sign-in suspends the platform account (the same state as freeze).
help.syncDisplayName: A rename in the directory follows into the platform on the next sign-in (it overwrites a name edited in the portal).

attribute.mail: Email (the sign-in identifier, must be unique)
attribute.userprincipalname: AD login name (with the domain suffix)
attribute.samaccountname: Windows login name (without the domain suffix)
attribute.objectguid: AD internal id (binary, survives an OU move)

linkPolicy.refuse: Reject the login and let an operator decide

reason.mail_unique: mail is on every sampled entry and unique: match on the email
reason.mail_duplicated: mail has duplicates, which would fail a login: use userPrincipalName instead
reason.user_principal_name_unique: userPrincipalName is unique: match on it
reason.login_name_unique: The login name attribute is unique: match on it
reason.no_unique_match_attribute: No candidate attribute is unique per user: set the filter by hand
reason.unique_id_present: A unique id attribute exists: the account survives an OU move or a rename
reason.unique_id_not_unique: The unique id attribute exists but has duplicates in the sample: confirm by hand
reason.no_unique_identifier: No unique id attribute found: logins fall back to the login name or DN, and moving an OU would create a second account
reason.login_name_missing: No login name attribute; the match attribute stands in for now
reason.no_display_name: No display name attribute: the platform shows the login name instead

uniqueIdSource.username: fell back to the login name

outcome.link: The directory identity is merged into the existing account (its local password stops working)
outcome.provision: A platform account is created on this first login
outcome.local_password: The directory has no such email: the local password is used
outcome.wrong_password_local_fallback: The password check failed (this account is not linked, so its local password still works)
outcome.no_directory_entry: No directory entry and no platform account: the login answers 401
outcome.refuse_privileged: Privileged account: the directory is skipped, only the local password counts
outcome.refuse_policy: The collision policy is refuse: no merge, the login is rejected
outcome.refuse_status: The platform account is not active
outcome.refuse_id_mismatch: The directory id differs from the linked one: the login is rejected
outcome.refuse_ambiguous: The email matches several directory entries: the login is rejected
outcome.refuse_not_provisioned: Auto-provisioning is off and no platform account exists

error.url_scheme: Must start with ldap:// or ldaps://
error.url_required: Required while directory login is enabled
error.timeout_range: The timeout must be between 1 and 60 seconds
error.filter_missing_placeholder: The filter must keep a %s placeholder, otherwise every login searches for the same entry
error.filter_required: Required while directory login is enabled
error.base_dn_required: Required while directory login is enabled
error.attr_unique_id_required: Required while directory login is enabled
error.attr_username_required: Required while directory login is enabled
error.attr_invalid: A bare attribute name, without spaces or parentheses
error.group_dn_invalid: Must be a DN, e.g. cn=team,dc=corp,dc=local

voiceAdmin.shortcutHint: A default key combination for everyone; each user can replace it or turn it off in their own Preferences. Empty = the platform offers no shortcut. While recording, the same key finishes the take.

voiceAdmin.batchHint: Re-transcribes the whole recording with an external model after you stop, and replaces the live text with it. Turn it on when you want it; the trigger decides when it runs.
voiceAdmin.batchTriggerManual: On demand (a button appears above the box)
voiceAdmin.polishSkipAfterBatch: Skip polish after the accurate pass

voiceAdmin.testNeedPermission: Microphone permission is required to test
